Harness brand assets

Brand names and marks identify the corresponding third-party products; they
belong to their respective owners and do not imply endorsement.

The following assets are bundled locally in src/renderer/src/assets/harness-brands:

claude.svg: Claude wordmark spark, https://claude.com/
openai.svg: OpenAI monoblossom, https://openai.com/brand/
kimi.png: https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-cli/blob/main/web/public/logo.png
opencode.png: https://opencode.ai/favicon-96x96-v3.png
glm.svg: https://z-cdn.chatglm.cn/z-ai/static/logo.svg
antigravity.png: https://antigravity.google/assets/image/antigravity-logo.png
grok.png: https://grok.com/images/android-chrome-192x192.png
mimo.png: https://platform.xiaomimimo.com/favicon.png
commandcode.png: https://commandcode.ai/favicon/2024/android-chrome-192x192.png
muse.svg: https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/rsrc.php/yf/r/-7pQO6hUGK_.svg
omp.svg: https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/blob/main/packages/collab-web/public/favicon.svg
hermes.svg: https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/blob/main/assets/icon-master.svg
github-copilot.svg: https://github.com/primer/octicons/blob/main/icons/copilot-16.svg
cline.svg: icon.svg from the official @cline/cli-darwin-arm64 3.0.73 package
devin.svg: https://devin.ai/favicon.svg
kilo.svg: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/blob/main/packages/kilo-docs/public/img/logo.svg

pi.svg, deepseek-color.svg, cursor.svg, geminicli-color.svg and zcode.png are
distributed in Magpie: https://github.com/yetone/magpie/tree/main/site/public/icons
Magpie identifies LobeHub Icons as a source: https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons
See the accompanying Magpie, LobeHub Icons and Octicons license notices.

The Muster Console mark is drawn by this application. An unknown custom
Harness is represented by its initial rather than a third-party logo.
